_comment: Curated historical episodes shown on the History page. Asset moves inside each window are computed from stored prices when the window is within the data history.

episodes.name: 2013 'taper tantrum' and gold crash
episodes.setup: Fed signals the end of QE; real yields jump; gold ETF outflows.
episodes.lesson: A break below a multi-month low in gold cascaded fast; equities rotated, not crashed.

episodes.name: 2014–16 oil glut
episodes.setup: OPEC defends market share while US shale grows; strong dollar.
episodes.lesson: Surplus narratives can run for quarters; rallies get sold until supply is cut.

episodes.name: Q4 2018: Fed hikes into a selloff
episodes.setup: Fed keeps hiking and shrinking its balance sheet while equities fall ~20%.
episodes.lesson: The equity low came when the Fed softened its tone (Jan 2019), not before.

episodes.name: 2020 Covid crash
episodes.setup: Pandemic shock; forced liquidation of everything, including gold.
episodes.lesson: In liquidations gold falls with stocks first, then leads the recovery once the Fed eases.

episodes.name: 2022 fastest hikes since Volcker
episodes.setup: Fed hikes 0.25% to 3.25% in seven months; dollar index hits 20-year high.
episodes.lesson: Strong dollar and rising real yields hurt gold less than feared, thanks to central-bank buying.

episodes.name: 2022 oil spike (Russia–Ukraine)
episodes.lesson: War premiums fade once supply adjusts; the peak came within four months.

episodes.name: 2026 Iran war and Hormuz closure
episodes.setup: US–Israel strikes on Iran; Strait of Hormuz closed; oil spike and global fuel crisis.
episodes.lesson: Supply shocks lift oil and inflation, which then forces central banks hawkish.

episodes.name: 2026 gold unwind and AI-stock correction
episodes.setup: Fed resumes hiking; AI leaders reprice; gold liquidated with stocks.
episodes.lesson: Current episode: track whether the 2013 analog keeps playing out.
